Descriptor offset 0x0 set to 34 (vertex buffer primitive type).
Descriptor offset 0xC set to 768 (vertex/element count, later loop bound).

sub_540DF0(dword_8B78A0, this+0xC) validates the descriptor against the device handle.
If sub_540DF0 returns nonzero, the function returns -1 before allocating the buffer.
Early failure exit returning -1 after descriptor validation fails.

Per-vertex init loop iterating count = descriptor+0xC (guard: count > 0): zero vertex+0x8, set vertex+0xC to 1.0f (1065353216), advance this+0x10 by 28 bytes per iteration.
